title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.3 (Peaked November 10, 2026 at 01:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 670 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Okay, that's some wind. 💨🌌👀

Several active regions and sunspot groups are clearly visible across the Sun today, with no obvious large coronagraphic eruption in this imagery.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
